conflicts.permit: We share the collected information with third-party business partners such as Facebook, MyFitnessPal, and Google.
conflicts.prohibit: We will not use HealthKit's API or its information for any purpose other than providing health and/or fitness services.
conflicts.situation: Sharing HealthKit health information with third-party business partners like Facebook or Google for advertising/partner purposes.
conflicts.reason: The third-parties section broadly permits sharing 'collected information' with partners who use it for ads, while the HealthKit clause strictly restricts HealthKit data use.
